subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving completed-ride volume for {Brand} in your live UK cities. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the completed ride and read it through a server-to-server postback held to the first settled fare, so cancelled and refunded trips drop out before billing and you pay only for riders who actually take a trip. At that quality we hold around 2,000 completed rides a day (illustrative). If it helps, I can share the city-level first-trip and second-ride view we are seeing. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate completed-ride postback proof
illustrative_flags: 2,000 completed rides a day (MobUpps daily completed-ride volume, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ride_hailing: references prior in S1; restates single proof (completed-ride optimization + S2S postback held to first settled fare); one illustrative figure (2,000 completed rides/day); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native English register; no sign-off; no 'X, not Y'.
